note: Rectangles [x, y, w, h] in viewport px, rounded to 0.01. Mock default context, on the list page of a connection. Scenes: closed; empty (open with no scope); scoped (open from the tab); query (`ods`, no scope: it matches the tab on screen and a page of two connections); none and noneScoped (`zzzzqq`, no scope and scoped); commands (`>` typed first, no scope). Read 700 ms after the last key, the pointer at (1, 1). Styles are named `<part>` or `<part>#<index>`.
